answer: Because the anchor decay is applied at each close, the crystal audit exposes the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A juror that skips cases loses 34% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool therefore watches its influence decay while paying the quartz fee to keep them eligible. Honest users pay that once, farms 28 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
